senses.gloss: ch.<cite ref="M02354">same</cite> <cite ref="Bava Batra 61b:1">B. Bath. 61ᵇ</cite> top <he>אע״ג דמ׳ ליה מצרי וכ׳</he> although he mentioned in the agreement the outer boundaries of the land.
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 61b:9">Ib.</cite> <he>הוה ליה למִימְצַר ליה ולא מ׳</he> he ought to have defined (the parts of the house which he sold), but did not do so.

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 70b:10">Ab. Zar. 70ᵇ</cite> <he>מימר אמר אַמִּצְרֵי דגג קמְצַרְנָא</he> Ms. M. (v. Rashi a. l.) he may say (I stretched my hand over to the neighbor’s roof, because) I wanted to measure the boundary lines on the roof; v. infra.

senses.gloss: to stretch one’s self. Ib. ed. אִימְּצוּרֵי קא מִמְּצַּרְנָא (not ממצרא; v. Rashi a. l., a. Koh. Ar. Compl. s. v. מצר; Rashi Var. אומצודי קא ממצדנא, corr. acc.) I stretched myself, v. מוּג ch.—[B. Bath. 6ᵇ מִמְּצוּרֵי קא מִמְּצִירְנָא, a gloss borrowed fr. Ab. Zar. l. c.; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 300.]
